sn35.23:1.1: Sāvatthi -- Tatra -- voca -- Sabbaṃ vo bhikkhave dessissāmi || tam suṇātha || || Kiñca bhikkhave sabbaṃ || || Cakkhuṃ ceva rūpā ca || Sotañca saddā ca || Ghānañca gandhā ca || Jivhā rasā ca || Kāyo ca phoṭṭhabbā ca || Mano ca dhammā ca || || Idam vuccati bhikkhave sabbaṃ || || Yo bhikkhave evam vadeyya || Aham etaṃ sabbam paccakkhāya aññaṃ sabbam paññāpessāmīti || tassa vācāvatthur evassa || puṭṭho ca na sampāpeyya || uttariñca vighātaṃ āpajjeyya || || Tam kissa hetu || yathā tam bhikkhave avisayasminti || ||
